title: RootNullAllOfMerge
$comment: Issue #267 (a). An object root whose shape comes from an allOf merge. generateAllOfDef hands generateStructDef a merged schema carrying the branch's properties and not the parent's "type", so the decoder's null question was asked of a schema nobody wrote and answered "null is fine": json.Unmarshal filled a nil map, the decode was a no-op, and Validate judged a zero struct. The identical schema written without the allOf around it has always refused one.
